text:
Gina L: quick postmortem follow-up from last night's vendor cascade (cloud IAM 429s -> model-registry flaps). i've sketched a compact action checklist: https://tracker.redwood/actions/INC-1120. please claim and add ETA.

Marco R: i'll own the registry read-through cache + snapshot. plan: tiny LRU for non-secret manifests (ttl=22s) + signed on-disk snapshot for critical configs. ETA: 2026-02-07.

Sam R: i'll take auth client hardening (backoff + token-bucket limiter) and the alerting work for auth_retry_ratio. ETA: 2026-02-05.

Tonya V: security/runbook owner - anything that stores manifests locally must be encrypted with KMS and have a signed manifest check. i'll update runbook and sign-off checklist. ETA: 2026-01-30.

ops-bot: Actions created: INC-1120-A1 (registry-cache), INC-1120-A2 (auth-hardening), INC-1120-A3 (runbook+kms). Owners must update status in tracker within 48h.

Gina L: observed pattern: spikes at midnight credential rotations + registry leader elections. retries amplify IAM throttles. short-term mitigations: small local cache, conservative retry budgets, and route to dedicated model-variants for 250ms before cross-region failover. also escalate to vendor for per-minute throttle thresholds.

Marco R: cache details i'll add to PR: max_entries=7k, ttl=22s, exclude presigned URLs. snapshot will be gzipped, signed, and versioned. adding integration test to simulate registry 5xx -> snapshot.

Sam R: proposed auth config (will open PR):
```
initial_backoff_ms: 150
max_retries: 3
max_backoff_ms: 3000
jitter: true
token_bucket: rate=60/s, burst=120
circuit_breaker: failures=8, window=60s
```
should cap retry storms while allowing quick transient recovery.

cloud-support-bot: Vendor ticket opened: CLOUD-IAM-55813. vendor requested request logs and client retry configs; please paste tracker links.

Tonya V: i'll add KMS rotation notes to runbook and require a secondary owner for any action >72h. ETA for docs: 2026-01-30.

Gina L: ops governance: label actions with estimated hours, add secondary owner for >72h, tag cross-team PRs with "ops-review-required", and schedule a 15m sync tomorrow to lock ETAs. owners please confirm by EOD.

Marco R: claimed INC-1120-A1, PR draft coming in ~4h.

Sam R: claimed INC-1120-A2, will open vendor case and paste ID.

Tonya V: claimed INC-1120-A3 and will update runbook tonight.

Gina L: thanks. i'll consolidate and post a short note to leadership after the sync. :thumbsup:
